mechanism: Selegiline (MAOI) combined with lisdexamfetamine (prodrug of dexamphetamine) creates risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome through inhibition of catecholamine metabolism and sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; selegiline must be discontinued at least 14 days before initiating lisdexamfetamine due to MAOI-sympathomimetic contraindication.
